subject: Year-end billing ladder, monthly drawdown cadence and VAT reconciliation - next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@greenfield.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Annual billing schedule + VAT info for 2026 reserved capacity

Hi Karthik,

We are preparing our FY2026 accounts and want to align on the billing approach for the reserved capacity committed under PO GF-8321. A few items we need to close on from our side:

- Confirm whether Redwood will issue a single annual invoice or an initial invoice followed by monthly drawdown statements/credit applications.
- Exact invoice dates (we aim to match our internal close on the last business day of May).
- VAT handling: we are an EU-registered entity (VAT ID attached), please confirm if you will apply reverse-charge or invoice with VAT.
- Any PO references or billing entity details you need from us.

Can you share a proposed billing ladder and a simple drawdown tracking approach so our AR team can reconcile easily? We have a PO ready (attached).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if useful.

Best,
Sofia Ruiz
Head of Finance
GreenField Analytics
attachments: GF_PO_8321.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-28T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Annual billing schedule + VAT info for 2026 reserved capacity

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the PO. Looping in our billing and finance leads to lock this down.

Top-line proposal from Redwood:
- We will issue an initial invoice for the reserved (annual committed) amount on the final business day of May (target: 2026-05-29). That invoice will reflect the gross committed amount.
- Starting on 2026-06-01 we will publish monthly drawdown statements (1st of each month) that show consumption applied against the committed balance, plus any overage usage. Credits are applied to the committed ledger in the same reporting row so your AR gets a single reconciliation line per month.
- If reverse-charge applies for your jurisdiction we will issue net (VAT-exempt) invoices and annotate them with the reverse-charge clause. If not, we will invoice inclusive of VAT. Please confirm the VAT ID (I see an attachment but we need the exact entity name to bill).
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date. Bank wiring instructions and Redwood EU billing entity options are in the attached schedule.

Attachments: GF_InvoiceSchedule_2026.xlsx (draft) — includes proposed invoice dates, numbering convention, and sample drawdown ledger format.

Action items for you: confirm which Redwood billing entity to use (Redwood Inference, Inc. - US vs Redwood Inference EU Ltd.), confirm VAT ID + registered entity name, and provide AR contact and PO number to stamp on the invoice.

If this looks OK I'll ask Marissa to finalize the invoice numbering and Lauren to add your AR contact to our monthly distribution list.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@greenfield.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T11:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Annual billing schedule + VAT info for 2026 reserved capacity

Hi Sofia — thanks for confirming the PO in your previous email. A few finance-level details so your AR team can reconcile smoothly: 

1) Invoice numbering and ledger
- Initial invoice (INV-2026-GF-0001) will be the committed amount. Monthly drawdown statements will be delivered as debit memo lines with a reference (DRW-YYYYMM-GF).

2) Drawdown reporting
- We will provide a shared reconciliation sheet (Drive link below) that is updated on the 1st of each month with: opening committed balance, monthly consumption, credits applied, closing balance.

3) VAT and withholding
- If GreenField provides an EU VAT ID and reverse-charge is applicable, we will issue net invoices and include the reverse-charge note. If your payments involve local withholding rules, please flag the jurisdiction so we can involve legal.

4) Payment details & remittance
- Our standard terms are Net 30. Wire instructions: Redwood Inference EU Ltd — IBAN: (stub) / SWIFT: RWDXEUXX. If you need Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) instead, let us know and we will route via our US AR desk.

5) Attachments provided for your AR team: drawdown-ledger-template.csv (sample), and the draft invoice schedule.

Drive link (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cGF-invoice-plan

If GreenField wants invoices issued quarterly instead of one annual bill + monthly drawdowns, we can update the schedule; that will change the timing of credits and may affect FX exposures.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-drawdown-ledger-template.csv
From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@greenfield.ai>

- VAT: GreenField Analytics BV (EU VAT ID NL123456789B01) — VAT_certificate_GreenField.pdf attached. Reverse-charge applies for most services, so please issue net invoices where possible.
- PO: GF-8321 (attached) – use the PO reference on all invoices.
- Billing entity: we prefer Redwood Inference EU Ltd. to avoid additional cross-border withholding.
- Payment cadence: we would prefer the initial invoice on 2026-05-29 but can request payment from our treasury to be scheduled on 2026-06-15 to align with our internal cashflow — please confirm the net 30 window will remain standard.

One question: can the drawdown statement include a per-feature breakdown (generation tokens vs embeddings) to help our internal chargeback? If not now, can we include it starting August statements?

Subject: Re: Year-end billing ladder, monthly drawdown cadence and VAT reconciliation - next steps

Thanks Sofia — this all works. Quick summary of confirmed items and next steps so we have a single thread for ops: 

Confirmed:
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference EU Ltd. — we will issue the initial invoice on 2026-05-29 (INV-2026-GF-0001) to match your requested close.
- VAT: we will issue net (reverse-charge) invoices to GreenField Analytics BV; VAT ID recorded as NL123456789B01.
- PO: GF-8321 will be stamped on every invoice and drawdown line.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date — please schedule payment per your treasury timeline; we acknowledge your planned payment on 2026-06-15.
- Drawdown cadence: monthly statements on the 1st (DRW-YYYYMM-GF). We will include a per-feature breakdown starting with the August 2026 statement as requested.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize invoice numbering and publish the shared reconciliation sheet (add GreenField AR contact).
- Lauren: add GreenField AR to monthly distribution and include attached drawdown template.
- Rachel/legal: confirm reverse-charge language for the invoice footer (Rachel will add the standard EU reverse-charge clause).
- Karthik: circulate final invoice schedule and confirm bank details in one consolidated PDF.

Attachments: final invoice schedule PDF will follow by EOD — for now use GF_InvoiceSchedule_2026.xlsx as the working draft.

If there are no objections we will proceed and you should see INV-2026-GF-0001 on 2026-05-29. Happy to set a recurring 20m month-end sync with your AR team (first meeting proposed 2026-06-02) — let me know preferred attendees.

Best regards,
